description: S3 storage provider (ADR-162). With STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3 and valid S3 config, presigned_url returns a SigV4 query-signed URL against S3_ENDPOINT_PUBLIC (never the internal endpoint): https://<public-host>/<bucket>/<key>?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=...&X-Amz-Signature=.... With STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3 and APP_ENV=production but placeholder/weak secrets or an internal presigned host, the binary refuses to boot (validate_storage_config) instead of silently falling back to local.

expected.note: with S3, clients use the presigned URL directly; the local HMAC download-by-ref endpoint 403s for S3 keys (the original's behaviour, ported)
